messages:
Eli: Weird combo day 1pm: a courier dropped off a boxed saxophone at Returns A3 labeled only 'Demo'. Also my sister is visiting with a foldable stroller and would love a seat with armrests. Any thoughts on where to park the stroller and where to seat her? Not urgent but appreciate recs.
Zoey: For seating with armrests, the guest chair in the quiet nook has armrests and it's usually free. Stroller can go by the bike rack if it's foldable.
Chris (mail): Sax box 1:02pm: I moved it to Secure Storage Rack 2 and put a fragile sticker on it. No recipient on the barcode. If it's a shared demo, we'll hold for 5 business days then ship to Lost & Found per policy.
Mina (facilities): Eli 1:05pm I can set up the quiet nook with a small side table and a non-slip mat for the stroller path. Leave it to me and I'll mark the route.
Diego (reception): I can pre-register Eli's sister and print an "Escort required" badge if she needs help getting past the turnstiles. Also will label the stroller "Eli guest" and leave a sticky.
MailBot: Delivery scanned: "Redline Couriers" 12:57 PM. Item: 1x "instrument case (fragile)". Location: Returns A3. No recipient on file. Automated hold initiated for 120h.
Harper: If the sax is for demos, it's probably for the Product Events team. I'll DM Kian. If unclaimed, can we put a note in the shared calendar so the events team sees it?
Eli: Thanks all. Diego 1:10pm yes please pre-print badge. Mina 1:12pm the mat & table sounds great. Chris 1:13pm thanks for the fragile tag — much appreciated. Harper 1:15pm please ping Events.
Zoey: Quick poll for seating: Quiet Nook (armrests) or High-top by kitchen (closer to snacks)? Quiet Nook so sister can sit comfortably = :one:, High-top for easy chat = :two:.
Harper: :one: for Quiet Nook. Less echo, better for a toddler nap if needed.
Diego (reception): Badge printed and labeled. Stroller sticky attached. I'll ring when they arrive.
Mina (facilities): Mat down, side table out, placed a small throw. Quiet Nook is good to go.
Chris (mail): Left a handwritten note on the sax box: "Secure Storage Rack 2 - MailOps" and updated the Returns A3 log.
Eli: All set — sister arriving ~1:20. Huge thanks everyone :heart:
